# Stone Arch Web Design

> One-page websites for small businesses in Minneapolis–St. Paul, Minnesota. $499 to build, $49 a month for hosting and edits. We make a free mockup of your site before you pay.

Stone Arch Web Design is run by Mohamed Yusuf, a software engineer in Minneapolis. You talk to the person who builds your site, not an agency.

## Who it is for

- Cafes, bakeries, restaurants, food trucks, salons, and local shops in Minneapolis and Saint Paul.
- Businesses with no website, or only a Square, Linktree, or social media page.

## Pricing

- One-page website: $499, one time. Mobile-first. Live in 2–3 days after we get your menu, photos, and hours.
- Monthly care: $49 a month. Hosting, security, and 2 small edits a month. 6-month minimum, then month to month.
- Web address (domain), if needed: about $13 a year, at cost.
- Leaving early: pay the months left in the first 6, or buy the site outright.

## How it works

1. We make a free mockup with your name, photos, and menu. No calls, no commitment.
2. If you like it, we build it for $499.
3. We keep it online for $49 a month.

## Contact

- Email: stonearchwebdesign@gmail.com (reply within one business day)
